translations.web: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
translations.bsb: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
translations.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
